title: sync_hop.c: Unsigned underflow when unix_time_ms < EPOCH_BASE_MS
description: Line 42: The subtraction unix_time_ms - EPOCH_BASE_MS has no bounds check. If unix_time_ms is before 2024-01-01 (e.g., GNSS not yet synced, RTC defaulting to 1970/2000, or uninitialized timestamp), the unsigned subtraction wraps to a huge positive value, returning garbage SFN. Fix: return 0 or error sentinel when unix_time_ms < EPOCH_BASE_MS.
close_reason: Already fixed: bounds check added at line 44 - returns 0 when unix_time_ms < EPOCH_BASE_MS to prevent unsigned underflow
